correctness.rationale: The exponent-kernel equivalence, lattice-primitivity criterion, fixed-lattice simplex count, and Mobius inversion were rederived and stress-tested. Exact checks on 2,184 bounded exponent vectors across five supports agreed with the two-prime specialization and the predicted asymptotic behavior.

originality.rationale: The 2013 Meštrović primary source, a 2026 follow-up preprint, current OEIS entries, synonymous searches, and the SCOPE archive were checked. Prior support and two-prime exponent criteria are explicitly excluded; no arbitrary-support lattice-primitivity theorem or fixed-support 1/zeta(s) primitive-density result was located. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with Wong's 1997 thesis as the main uninspected risk.

value.rationale: The theorem provides a canonical structural model for every fixed admissible support, a basis-independent primitive criterion, and a universal density law. It also gives an explicit normalized-gcd classification for every two-prime support.
